subject: Nicole Branley School Committee Re-election Platform
overview: School Committee member Nicole Branley appeared on Medford Happenings to discuss her re-election campaign and priorities for the district. Key topics included the impact of the recent tax override, the status of the high school building project, and the success of vocational-technical programs.

items.title: Introduction and Candidate Background
items.summary: Host John Petrella introduced School Committee member Nicole Branley, who discussed her history as a Medford native, parent, and former district employee.

items.title: Motivations for Re-election
items.summary: Branley explained her desire to serve a second term to continue representing all citizens and advocating for students and staff.

items.title: Policy Accomplishments and Administrative Searches
items.summary: The candidate highlighted her work on the district's bullying and intervention policy and her participation in the search committee for the new principal.

items.title: Budget and Tax Override Status
items.summary: Branley discussed the importance of the recent tax override in securing positions and funding essential building maintenance.

items.title: District Leadership and Priorities
items.summary: The discussion addressed the transition to interim superintendent Dr. Galussi and Branley's focus on academic excellence and community pride.

items.title: Teachers' Contract and Learning Time
items.summary: Branley reported that the recently finalized teachers' contract will include an increase in weekly instructional time for students.

items.title: High School Building Project Update
items.summary: The discussion covered the MSBA process for renovating or rebuilding the high school, which is currently in its third phase of planning.

items.title: Vocational and Technical Education
items.summary: Branley highlighted the success and high demand for the Medford Vocational Technical High School programs, noting the current waiting lists for enrollment.

items.title: Community Reflections and Campaign Contact Information
items.summary: The program concluded with a discussion on local traffic and community spaces, followed by contact information for the Branley campaign.
